## Overview

Handle two elements at the same time for per token group quant

Using specific instruction __nv_fp8x2_e4m3, __hmin2 etc to get additional perf

## Test

```bash
vllm serve zai-org/GLM-5.3 \
    --trust-remote-code \
    -tp 4 \
    --load-format fastsafetensors \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.88 \
    --enable-prefix-caching \
    --host 0.0.0.0 \
    --port 9256 \
    --max-model-len auto \
    --max-num-seqs 48 \
    --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":5}'
```

### Acc

```bash
lm_eval --model local-completions --model_args "base_url=http://127.0.0.1:9256/v1/completions,model=$MODEL,num_concurrent=1024" --tasks gsm8k --trust_remote_code

lm eval
|Tasks|Version|     Filter     |n-shot|  Metric   |   |Value |   |Stderr|
|-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|---|-----:|---|-----:|
|gsm8k|      3|flexible-extract|     5|exact_match|↑  |0.9234|±  |0.0073|
|     |       |strict-match    |     5|exact_match|↑  |0.9234|±  |0.0073|
```
